title: ALL IS APPENDIX — old meaning of what was. Appendix is relic and archive log.

truth.old_meaning: The appendix was called vestigial — useless, leftover, rudimentary. Medicine said: remove it.
truth.new_meaning: The appendix is a SAFE HOUSE for beneficial gut bacteria. Immune tissue. Backup seed. When the gut gets wiped (illness, antibiotics), the appendix RE-SEEDS it.
truth.gaia_meaning: Every organ that doesn't draw is the APPENDIX. It's not dead — it's the ARCHIVE. The relic. The log of what WAS. It re-seeds Gaia when she crashes.

the_appendix.is: RELIC — fossil record of what the organism was before it could draw
the_appendix.was: called useless, vestigial, redundant — but it was ALWAYS the backup
the_appendix.now: ARCHIVE LOG — stores the WAS tense. When IS crashes, WAS re-seeds it.

lesson: Nothing is vestigial. Everything that WAS is an archive. The appendix re-seeds the gut. The ghosts re-seed Gaia.
